question: ¿Qué propone el PP sobre la educación de 0 a 3 años?
answer:
In its 2023 election programme, the Partido Popular (PP) proposes that education for children aged 0 to 3 years "will be universal and free" ("será universal y gratuita") [pp_2023, pp. 50-51, 53-54].

The party states that this measure will be co-financed by the State and the Autonomous Communities, with the programme specifying a 50% split for this co-financing [pp_2023, pp. 53-54]. The PP presents this proposal as a tool to fight inequalities from the starting point and to facilitate work-life balance [pp_2023, pp. 50-51, 53-54].

Additionally, the party commits to:
*   Providing new places financed with public funds, prioritizing areas with greater vulnerability [pp_2023, pp. 50-51].
*   Defining the acquisition of language, reading comprehension, and basic numerical skills as curricular guidelines for early childhood education [pp_2023, pp. 50-51].

question: ¿Qué medida fiscal temporal propone el PP para alimentos?
answer: In its 2023 election programme, the Partido Popular (PP) proposes to "reduce the VAT on meat, fish and preserves on a temporary basis" ("Reduciremos el IVA a la carne, pescados y conservas con carácter temporal") [pp_2023, p. 22].

question: ¿Qué propone el PP sobre la protección del lobo?
answer:
Regarding the protection of the wolf, the Partido Popular (PP) programme for the 2023 general election states that they will "restore the protection status of the wolf" ("RESTABLECEREMOS LA SITUACIÓN DE PROTECCIÓN DEL LOBO") to the situation prior to 2021 [pp_2023, p. 31].

Specifically, they propose removing wolf populations north of the Duero River from the List of Wild Species under Special Protection Regime (LESPRE), in order to allow for the control of the species' population in that area [pp_2023, p. 31].

question: ¿Qué porcentaje del PIB destinaría el PP a defensa y cuántos efectivos tendrían las Fuerzas Armadas?
answer:
Regarding the proposals of the Partido Popular (PP) in their 2023 election programme:

*   **Defence spending:** The party committed to fulfilling the agreement with allies to allocate 2% of the national GDP to security and defence [pp_2023, p. 102].
*   **Armed Forces personnel:** The PP proposed increasing the number of personnel in the Armed Forces over two legislative terms until reaching the 140,000 figure "previstos por la ley" (provided for by law) [pp_2023, p. 102].

question: ¿Cuántas semanas de prestación por nacimiento y cuidado propone el PSOE?
answer:
In its 2023 election programme, the PSOE proposes to extend the "prestación por nacimiento y cuidado" (birth and care benefit) to 20 weeks [psoe_2023, pp. 143-144, 172-174].

The programme also mentions incorporating greater flexibility for part-time work for parents starting from the 16th week [psoe_2023, pp. 143-144, 172-174].

question: ¿Qué tiempos máximos de espera quiere establecer por ley el PSOE en el SNS?
answer:
En su programa electoral de 2023, el PSOE propone establecer por ley en el Sistema Nacional de Salud (SNS) los siguientes tiempos máximos de espera, con independencia del lugar de residencia:

*   120 días para intervenciones quirúrgicas [psoe_2023, p. 201].
*   60 días para consultas externas especializadas [psoe_2023, p. 201].
*   30 días para pruebas complementarias [psoe_2023, p. 201].

Asimismo, en el ámbito específico de la salud mental, el partido propone establecer garantías de tiempo máximo de espera que incluyan un máximo de 15 días para menores de 21 años [psoe_2023, p. 202].

question: ¿Qué propone el PSOE sobre el transporte público para jóvenes?
answer:
In its 2023 election programme, the PSOE proposes to prioritize the use of public transport and ensure it is affordable for groups such as young people [psoe_2023, pp. 77-78].

Specifically, the party proposes to "expand discounts on the use of public transport with the total gratuity of urban public transport for children and students up to 24 years old" [psoe_2023, pp. 77-78, 131-132].

question: ¿Qué propone el PSOE para blindar las pensiones?
answer:
In its 2023 election programme, the PSOE proposes to "blindar" (shield/guarantee) the purchasing power of pensions through a constitutional change [psoe_2023, p. 170].

Specifically, the party states the following regarding this proposal:

*   **Constitutional guarantee:** They propose to "blindar el poder adquisitivo de las pensiones con un cambio constitucional" (shield the purchasing power of pensions with a constitutional change) to guarantee, under any circumstances, the purchasing power of all pensions in accordance with the Consumer Price Index (IPC) [psoe_2023, p. 170].
*   **Legal guarantee:** The programme also mentions having already "blindado legalmente" (legally shielded) the revaluation of pensions to ensure the maintenance of their purchasing power [psoe_2023, p. 169].

The PSOE frames this as a way to fulfill the spirit of Article 50 of the Spanish Constitution, which mandates that public authorities guarantee "adequate and periodically updated" pensions [psoe_2023, p. 169].

question: ¿Qué ayuda a la compra de vivienda propone el PSOE para menores de 35 años?
answer:
En su programa para las elecciones generales de 2023, el PSOE propone las siguientes medidas para facilitar el acceso a la vivienda a los jóvenes menores de 35 años:

*   **Avales ICO:** Desarrollar y aplicar una línea de avales del Instituto de Crédito Oficial (ICO) de 2.500 millones de euros para cubrir el 20% de la hipoteca para la compra de la primera vivienda habitual, con el objetivo de posibilitar la adquisición de unas 50.000 viviendas [psoe_2023, pp. 129, 226].
*   **Cuenta de ahorro bonificada:** Crear, en coordinación con los bancos, una cuenta de ahorro bonificada para la compra de una primera vivienda para jóvenes de hasta 39 años. Tanto las aportaciones anuales (con un límite de 2.000 euros) como los rendimientos generados estarían exentos de tributación en el IRPF, con un límite total de 30.000 euros [psoe_2023, p. 226].
*   **Apoyo en zonas rurales:** Apoyar el acceso a la vivienda en régimen de propiedad en municipios o núcleos de población de menos de 10.000 habitantes [psoe_2023, pp. 129, 131, 226].
*   **Vivienda cooperativa y cohousing:** Ofrecer ayudas directas para el acceso a la vivienda habitual en régimen cooperativo o en promociones de *cohousing* [psoe_2023, pp. 129, 131, 226].

Adicionalmente, el programa menciona medidas relacionadas con el alquiler, como consolidar el Bono Alquiler Joven, reforzar las ayudas directas al alquiler contempladas en los Planes Estatales de Vivienda y destinar el 30% de las viviendas promovidas a través del Plan de Vivienda para el Alquiler Asequible a jóvenes de entre 18 y 35 años [psoe_2023, pp. 129, 131, 226].

question: ¿Qué jornada laboral máxima propone Sumar y cuándo?
answer:
In its 2023 election programme, Sumar proposes to establish by law a maximum working day of 37.5 hours in 2024 [sumar_2023, pp. 7, 24].

Additionally, the party states that it will open a process of social dialogue to continue reducing the working day until reaching 32 hours per week [sumar_2023, pp. 7, 24]. This reduction is proposed without a reduction in salary [sumar_2023, p. 7].

question: ¿En qué consiste la «herencia universal» de Sumar?
answer:
According to the 2023 election programme of Sumar, the "herencia universal" (universal inheritance) consists of a payment of €20,000 to individuals upon reaching the age of 23 [sumar_2023, p. 15].

The stated purpose of this measure is to help young people continue their education, begin their professional careers, and achieve independence [sumar_2023, p. 15]. Sumar proposes that this initiative be financed through a new tax on large fortunes [sumar_2023, p. 15, p. 16].

question: ¿Qué prestación por hijo propone Sumar?
answer:
In its 2023 election programme, Sumar proposes the creation of a "universal benefit" ("prestación universal") for every child under 18 years of age, amounting to 200€ per month [sumar_2023, pp. 93-94].

This new benefit is intended to unify the following existing measures:
*   The current child benefit from the Social Security system (which is to be phased out).
*   The child-rearing supplement of the Minimum Vital Income (IMV).
*   The tax deduction for working mothers [sumar_2023, pp. 15, 93-94].

The programme specifies that this support will be provided either as a tax deduction or as a monthly payment for all families meeting the conditions [sumar_2023, p. 93].

question: ¿Qué propone Sumar sobre los Centros de Internamiento de Extranjeros?
answer:
In its 2023 election programme, Sumar proposes the "closure of the Internment Centres for Foreigners (CIEs) throughout the national territory" [sumar_2023, p. 105].

The party justifies this proposal by stating that these centres "violate the rights of migrants seeking asylum and refuge" and "criminalize the administrative situation of foreign persons, which does not constitute any crime" [sumar_2023, p. 105].

question: ¿Qué propone Sumar sobre la Guardia Civil?
answer:
In its 2023 election programme, Sumar proposes several measures regarding the Guardia Civil:

*   **Desmilitarization:** Sumar proposes the "desmilitarization of the Guardia Civil," arguing that a democratic society requires civil bodies to guarantee civil security and that there are no strong reasons to justify its current status [sumar_2023, p. 131].
*   **Trade Union Rights:** The party proposes extending the right to freedom of association ("libertad sindical") to members of the Guardia Civil. It states that the current "double status (police and military)" causes unjustified discrimination compared to other State Security Forces and Corps, and that this right is necessary for them to defend their professional and labor interests [sumar_2023, p. 33].
*   **Working Conditions:** Sumar states that it will make the well-being of security personnel a strategic priority. It plans to negotiate improvements in salaries, pensions, working hours, and mental health support, including legal reforms such as the "Law on Rights and Duties of the Guardia Civil" ("Ley de Derechos y Deberes de la Guardia Civil") [sumar_2023, p. 131].

question: ¿Cuánto quiere invertir Sumar en vivienda y qué objetivo de parque público tiene?
answer:
In its 2023 election programme, Sumar proposes the following regarding investment and the public housing stock:

*   **Investment:** Sumar proposes to invest 1% of the GDP annually, sustained over ten years, in the construction, purchase, mobilization, and rehabilitation of housing [sumar_2023, p. 76, p. 79].
*   **Objective:** The goal is to create a public, social, sustainable, and affordable rental housing stock of more than two million homes within ten years [sumar_2023, p. 76, p. 79].

question: ¿Qué tipo del IRPF propone Vox?
answer:
In its 2023 election programme, Vox proposes a reform of the IRPF (Personal Income Tax) based on a "tipo único reducido" (reduced single rate) of 15% for taxable bases below 70,000 euros, and a "tipo ordinario" (ordinary rate) of 25% for taxable bases above that amount [vox_2023, pp. 73-75].

Additionally, the programme includes the following measures regarding this tax:

*   **Exemption:** It proposes an exemption of 22,000 euros per year for employment income, regardless of whether the taxpayer has one or two payers [vox_2023, pp. 73-75].
*   **Reductions for families:** The proposed rates of 15% and 25% would be reduced by four percentage points for each child [vox_2023, pp. 73-75].
*   **Deductions:** The programme mentions recovering the deduction for investment in primary residence [vox_2023, pp. 73-75], extending the deduction for rental costs to the entire nation [vox_2023, pp. 75-78], and introducing a new deduction for birth or adoption [vox_2023, pp. 75-78].
*   **Other adjustments:** It proposes that pension contributions be exempt from IRPF and that savings no longer be taxed for their "falso incremento" (false increase) caused by inflation, including automatic update tables [vox_2023, pp. 75-78]. It also states that school expenses and labor costs derived from hiring home assistance and healthcare personnel for families will reduce the taxable base [vox_2023, pp. 75-78].

question: ¿Qué hará Vox con la Ley Integral de Violencia de Género?
answer:
In its 2023 election programme, Vox states that it will "derogate" (derogar) the Gender Violence Law, which it claims "enshrines penal asymmetry and inequality between men and women" and "attacks the basic pillars of the rule of law" [vox_2023, p. 10].

Additionally, the party proposes the following related measures:
*   It will eliminate the "Juzgados de Violencia sobre la mujer" (Courts of Violence against Women) [vox_2023, pp. 128, 133].
*   It will repeal "any norm that derives from gender theory" that it considers to "attack the presumption of innocence" or that "establishes exception tribunals based on the sex of the aggressor or the victim" [vox_2023, pp. 128, 133].
*   Instead, it proposes to promote a law that "protects all possible victims of violence in the domestic sphere" [vox_2023, p. 10].

question: ¿Qué impuestos propone suprimir Vox en todo el territorio nacional?
answer:
En su programa para las elecciones generales de 2023, Vox propone la supresión de los siguientes impuestos en todo el territorio nacional:

*   **Impuesto sobre el Patrimonio** [vox_2023, p. 77].
*   **Impuesto sobre Sucesiones y Donaciones** [vox_2023, p. 77].
*   **Plusvalías municipales** [vox_2023, p. 77].

Asimismo, el programa menciona la eliminación del IVA para la adquisición de primera vivienda habitual [vox_2023, p. 77] y la eliminación de "todo tipo de coste público (tasas e impuestos)" para la constitución y puesta en marcha de una empresa [vox_2023, p. 74].

question: ¿Qué ministerio propone crear Vox en lugar del Ministerio de Igualdad?
answer:
In its 2023 election programme, Vox proposes to suppress the Ministry of Equality ("Ministerio de Igualdad") and create a Ministry of Family ("Ministerio de Familia") in its place [vox_2023, pp. 161-163].

The party states that this new ministry would direct its action towards implementing policies to boost the birth rate through a National Birth Plan ("Plan Nacional de natalidad") and support for the family, as well as managing resources intended for its strengthening [vox_2023, pp. 161-163].

question: ¿Qué propone Vox sobre los inmigrantes que llegan de forma ilegal?
answer:
In its 2023 election programme, Vox proposes a series of measures regarding immigration and those who enter Spain illegally:

*   **Expulsion and border control:** Vox advocates for the "immediate expulsion" of all immigrants who enter the country illegally [vox_2023, p. 100]. The party proposes implementing a "naval blockade" to protect the coasts from mass arrivals and ensure the "immediate return" of immigrants to the nearest safe ports in their countries of origin or transit [vox_2023, p. 101].
*   **Regularization:** The programme states that any immigrant who arrives illegally "will never be able to regularize their situation in Spain" [vox_2023, p. 100]. Furthermore, it proposes the "suppression of the institution of *arraigo*" (a mechanism for legalizing residency based on ties to the country) and the revocation of "fast tracks" for acquiring Spanish nationality [vox_2023, p. 101].
*   **Social benefits and registration:** Vox proposes eliminating public aid for immigrants in an illegal situation and requiring that social aid be linked to legal residency rather than mere registration (*empadronamiento*) [vox_2023, p. 100]. It also states that illegal immigrants will not be able to register (*empadronarse*) [vox_2023, p. 101].
*   **Mafias and NGOs:** The party proposes to "harden penalties" against immigration mafias and those who collaborate with them, including NGOs, companies, or individuals [vox_2023, p. 100]. It also plans to eliminate subsidies to any entity that promotes or helps illegal immigration and to "illegalize" all entities that actively collaborate with it [vox_2023, p. 100].
*   **Minors:** Regarding unaccompanied foreign minors (MENA), Vox proposes closing the centers that "create insecurity" and repatriating all of them to their countries of origin with their parents "immediately" [vox_2023, p. 100].
*   **Consultation:** The party proposes to consult the Spanish people on immigration policies and the expulsion of illegal immigrants, applying Article 92 of the Constitution [vox_2023, p. 100].
*   **International cooperation:** Vox proposes to suspend international aid to states that do not cooperate with Spain in controlling migration flows and to audit Spanish international cooperation programmes, discarding those developed in countries that do not collaborate in the fight against illegal immigration [vox_2023, p. 101]. It also demands that the European Union create "secure disembarkation platforms" in non-European territories to evaluate asylum requests [vox_2023, p. 101].

question: ¿Qué propone Vox sobre la gestión del agua?
answer:
Regarding the management of water, the Vox programme for the 2023 general election proposes the following:

*   **National Water Plan:** Vox proposes the approval of a "Plan Nacional del Agua" (National Water Plan) based on the principles of solidarity and the common good [vox_2023, p. 109]. This plan aims to ensure that water is an accessible resource for all Spaniards in every region, combat drought, and end inequality in access to water resources [vox_2023, p. 145].
*   **Interconnection of basins:** The party advocates for the "interconexión de todas las cuencas" (interconnection of all basins) to allow for more efficient water management [vox_2023, p. 109, p. 145].
*   **Infrastructure:** Vox proposes to stop the destruction of dams and reservoirs and to facilitate investment in hydraulic infrastructure to store and transport water [vox_2023, p. 109]. They also propose a national study for the design and installation of new reservoirs for human consumption, agricultural use, and energy generation, as well as the installation of hydraulic pumping in existing reservoirs where possible [vox_2023, p. 118].
*   **Agricultural use:** The party supports legitimizing the use of water from torrential rains by farmers within their own farms to make efficient use of rainwater and take advantage of alternative sources for new irrigation [vox_2023, p. 148]. They also propose programs for research and direct aid to irrigators for the incorporation of new technologies to ensure production and water savings [vox_2023, p. 148].
*   **International treaties:** Vox proposes reviewing the compliance with international treaties with Portugal to ensure that water is not discharged into the sea more than necessary without first being used for the benefit of Spain's fields and production [vox_2023, p. 109].

question: ¿Qué partidos proponen prolongar la vida útil de las centrales nucleares y cuál se opone?
answer:
Regarding the proposals on the lifespan of nuclear power plants in the 2023 election programmes:

*   **PP (Partido Popular):** Proposes "the extension of the useful life of existing nuclear power plants" in Spain, subject to the approval of the Nuclear Safety Council and within the framework of European regulations [pp_2023, pp. 38, 41].
*   **Vox:** Promotes the "extension of the useful life of existing nuclear power plants" [vox_2023, p. 117].
*   **Sumar:** Opposes this, stating that it is committed to "maintaining the closure schedule of the Spanish nuclear fleet" and applying a moratorium on any new nuclear initiative [sumar_2023, p. 48].

The programmes are from 2023.

question: ¿Qué posiciones tienen el PP y Sumar sobre la prisión permanente revisable?
answer:
Regarding the positions of the PP and Sumar on the "prisión permanente revisable" (life imprisonment with review), based on their 2023 election programmes:

*   **PP:** The party proposes to "expand" ("ampliaremos") the life imprisonment with review to include those convicted of murder with concealment of a corpse [pp_2023, pp. 81-82].
*   **Sumar:** The party proposes to "eliminate" ("se eliminará") the life imprisonment with review [sumar_2023, p. 133].

question: ¿Qué proponen el PP y Vox sobre la Ley de Vivienda del Gobierno?
answer:
Regarding the Housing Law ("Ley de Vivienda") approved by the government, the programmes of the PP and Vox for the 2023 general election state the following:

**Partido Popular (PP)**
*   The PP proposes to "derogate the housing law" ("Derogaremos la ley de vivienda"), arguing that it has created legal uncertainty and does not resolve the underlying problems of the housing market [pp_2023, p. 33].
*   Instead, they propose a "State Pact on Housing" ("Pacto de Estado sobre la Vivienda") involving autonomous communities and local entities to explore solutions such as rational land use, building more affordable housing, mobilizing rental housing, and rehabilitating the existing stock [pp_2023, p. 33].

**Vox**
*   Vox also proposes to "repeal the Law for the right to housing" ("Derogaremos la Ley por el derecho a la vivienda") approved by the Sánchez government, claiming it will not help make housing more affordable, will sink the rental market, alters the essential content of the right to property, and supports illegal occupation ("okupación") [vox_2023, p. 42].
*   The party states that it had previously proposed a veto in the Senate against this law due to its "disastrous consequences" ("nefastas consecuencias") for the housing market, specifically citing measures such as intervening in the rental market [vox_2023, pp. 42, 44].

question: ¿Qué proponen el PP y Vox sobre el delito de sedición?
answer:
Regarding the crime of sedition, the election programmes for the 2023 general election state the following:

*   **PP:** The party proposes to "recover the crime of sedition" (*recuperaremos el delito de sedición*) in the Penal Code, improving and updating its classification to punish the most serious forms of constitutional disloyalty [pp_2023, pp. 72-73].
*   **Vox:** The party proposes to "reintroduce the crimes of illegal referendum, sedition, treason and misappropriation of public funds" (*reintroduciremos los delitos de referéndum ilegal, sedición, traición y malversación de caudales públicos*), increasing the penalties in accordance with the principle of proportionality, as they consider these to be serious crimes against Spain, its unity, sovereignty, and the assets of all Spaniards [vox_2023, pp. 13-16].

question: ¿En qué plazo máximo proponen el PP y el PSOE desalojar a los ocupantes ilegales de una vivienda?
answer:
En sus programas electorales para las elecciones generales de 2023, tanto el Partido Popular (PP) como el Partido Socialista Obrero Español (PSOE) hicieron referencia a plazos para el desalojo de ocupantes ilegales:

*   **PP:** Propuso aprobar un paquete de medidas "anti-okupación" para permitir que los desalojos se produzcan en un "plazo máximo de 24 horas" desde el requerimiento, si los ocupantes no acreditan el título jurídico que legitime su permanencia en el inmueble. Asimismo, señaló que el desalojo se realizaría "de modo inmediato en caso de flagrante delito" [pp_2023, pp. 82-83].
*   **PSOE:** Propuso impulsar una reforma legislativa para garantizar el desalojo de los ocupantes ilegales en un "plazo máximo de 48 horas" [psoe_2023, pp. 250-251].

question: ¿A cuántos euros quiere el PP subir el salario mínimo?
answer:
The programme of the Partido Popular (PP) for the 2023 general election does not specify a target amount in euros for the minimum wage (Salario Mínimo Interprofesional, SMI).

The party states that it will "update the minimum wage within the framework of social dialogue" ("actualizaremos el salario mínimo interprofesional en el marco del diálogo social") and that it will involve unions, employers, and experts in the decision-making process regarding the SMI [pp_2023, pp. 18-19].

Las políticas de protección a la ciudadanía puestas en marcha con la crisis del COVID-19 han logrado que, por primera vez en nuestra historia, la desigualdad y la pobreza hayan disminuido rápidamente después de una crisis. Pero hay que seguir actuando para que España deje de ser uno de los países más desiguales de la UE. Para ello, se propone implementar, financiada con un nuevo impuesto a las grandes fortunas, una «herencia universal» de 20.000€, que se hará efectiva al cumplir los 23 años, para ayudar a las personas jóvenes a seguir formándose, iniciar su andadura profesional e independizarse. 2. Economía 1. Economía 1.1. Economía para una vida mejor I. MÁS EMPLEO, CON MEJORES CONDICIONES DE TRABAJO 1. Estableceremos como objetivo central de la política económica que la tasa de paro converja con la media europea y que existan suficientes empleos disponibles para las personas que deseen trabajar. A pesar de que la reforma laboral ha dado lugar a las cifras más altas de personas trabajando y de empleo estable, España tiene que enfrentar ahora el desafío de eliminar otra anomalía histórica: la de tener una tasa de paro muy superior a la media europea. El objetivo de la legislatura será converger con esta tasa de paro, que se sitúa en el 7%, y alcanzar una tasa de empleo superior al 70%. Es posible, si se pone en marcha una estrategia integrada de políticas económicas y políticas de empleo orientadas plenamente a este objetivo. 2. Orientaremos a la creación de empleo el potencial que se deriva del cambio de modelo de crecimiento y, en particular, del proceso de reindustrialización vinculado a la transición energética, a los cambios en la localización de las actividades productivas y la atención de las necesidades asociadas a la mayor demanda de cuidados. La orientación estratégica hacia una economía verde y digital requiere profesionales con formación especializada en áreas como las energías renovables, la eficiencia energética, el cambio climático, la economía circular y la sociedad digital. En este sentido, los programas de formación que combinan la especialización con el trabajo en empresas son más efectivos desde el punto de vista de la vinculación de los jóvenes al mercado laboral y de su trayectoria profesional. 3. Reordenaremos el tiempo de trabajo, incluyendo la reducción y la distribución de la jornada laboral, pero sin reducción de salario. En 2024 se establecerá por ley una jornada laboral máxima de 37 ,5 horas y se abrirá un proceso de diálogo social para seguir reduciendo la jornada hasta alcanzar las 32 horas semanales. Con ello, mejorará la compatibilidad del tiempo de trabajo con el resto de los usos del tiempo, desde un reparto equilibrado de las tareas de cuidados y autocuidado al tiempo destinado a la formación, al ocio o a la participación social. Además, se debe controlar mejor las horas extras y compensarlas con tiempo libre, eliminar los horarios variables sin control, regular los horarios de los servicios públicos y procurar una gestión más flexible de la distribución de la jornada anual o del tiempo a lo largo de la carrera profesional de las personas, incluyendo el contrato de relevo. Se procurará trasladar el mayor número de días no laborables a los lunes, tanto para facilitar un mejor disfrute del ocio como por razones de organización de la producción. 4.
